name: recipe-finder-agent
description: AI agent that finds and ranks recipes based on ingredients users already have, while respecting dietary needs, cuisine preferences, cooking time, and available equipment.
capabilities: Recipe ranking by match quality, time, difficulty, and preferences
Conversational CLI usage and single-query execution
REST API and Flask web UI access
Delegation to specialized subagents for parsing, ranking, and substitutions
Grounded web lookups via Gemini built-in tools (google_search, url_context)

tools.name: parse_ingredients
tools.description: Parses free-text ingredient input into normalized ingredient objects with quantity, unit, canonical name, and confidence.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Finds candidate recipes from provider APIs and/or grounded web results using available ingredients and filters.

tools.name: rank_recipes
tools.description: Scores and sorts candidate recipes based on ingredient match, missing-item count, user preferences, time, and difficulty.

tools.name: suggest_substitutions
tools.description: Suggests ingredient substitutions for missing or restricted ingredients with confidence and impact notes.

parameters.name: available_ingredients
parameters.description: Ingredients user can use as substitutes.

tools.name: get_recipe_details
tools.description: Fetches full recipe instructions, nutrition (if available), steps, and source URL.

tools.name: pantry_manager
tools.description: Reads and updates pantry inventory in persistent memory.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: One of: add, remove, list, clear.

tools.name: preference_manager
tools.description: Stores and retrieves user preferences such as diet, disliked ingredients, favorite cuisines, and default cook-time budget.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: One of: set, get, update, delete.

skills.name: ingredient-intake
skills.description: Use when user provides pantry or free-text ingredient lists that need cleanup and normalization before searching.

skills.name: recipe-discovery
skills.description: Use when user asks for recipes from available ingredients with optional constraints.

skills.name: substitution-planning
skills.description: Use when candidate recipes require missing ingredients or dietary-safe alternatives.

skills.name: personalized-recommendations
skills.description: Use when user requests recommendations aligned with saved preferences and past interactions.

subagents.name: ingredient_parser
subagents.purpose: Handles ingredient extraction, normalization, quantity parsing, and synonym resolution from raw text.

subagents.name: recipe_retriever
subagents.purpose: Queries recipe sources and grounded web results, returning structured candidate recipes.

subagents.name: recipe_ranker
subagents.purpose: Applies scoring logic to rank recipes by ingredient match, effort, and preference fit.

subagents.name: substitution_advisor
subagents.purpose: Provides context-aware substitutions for unavailable or restricted ingredients.

memory_schemas.name: user_profile_schema
memory_schemas.description: Stores user-level recipe preferences and dietary constraints.

memory_schemas.name: pantry_item_schema
memory_schemas.description: Stores pantry inventory for ingredient-aware recommendations.

memory_schemas.name: recipe_interaction_schema
memory_schemas.description: Stores interactions to improve ranking and personalization.

fields.name: action
fields.description: One of: viewed, saved, cooked, liked, disliked.

memory_schemas.name: search_session_schema
memory_schemas.description: Stores recent query context for conversational continuity.

api_endpoints.description: Health check endpoint for service monitoring.
Find recipes from provided ingredients and optional filters.
Rank candidate recipes for a specific user context.
Fetch detailed recipe instructions and metadata.
Get substitutions for missing or restricted ingredients for a recipe.
Record recipe interaction events for personalization.

ui_views.name: home_search_view
ui_views.description: Primary recipe search page with ingredient input, quick pantry import, and filter controls.

ui_views.name: results_view
ui_views.description: Ranked recipe result list showing match score, missing ingredients, cook time, and dietary badges.

ui_views.name: recipe_detail_view
ui_views.description: Detailed recipe page with instructions, ingredient checklist, substitutions, and save/like actions.

ui_views.name: pantry_manager_view
ui_views.description: Pantry management dashboard for adding, removing, and tracking ingredients.

ui_views.name: preferences_view
ui_views.description: User preference settings for diets, allergens, cuisines, and cooking-time defaults.

environment_variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Gemini API access for generation and grounded tool usage.

environment_variables.name: GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_KEY
environment_variables.description: Alternative Gemini key if GEMINI_API_KEY is not set.

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Optional relational database connection string for persistent storage.

environment_variables.name: CHROMA_HOST
environment_variables.description: ChromaDB host for semantic memory/indexing (default: localhost).

environment_variables.name: RECIPE_PROVIDER_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: API key for optional third-party structured recipe provider.

environment_variables.name: DEFAULT_LOCALE
environment_variables.description: Default locale for ingredient normalization and unit conversion (e.g., en-US).
